description: This file defines the Slim Framework's CallableResolver class, which implements logic to resolve callables, routes, and middleware components, including handling container integration and notation parsing.

classes.name: CallableResolver
classes.description: Final class implementing AdvancedCallableResolverInterface, responsible for resolving callables, routes, and middleware, with container support and notation parsing.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given input into a callable, handling string notation and container binding.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route handler, defaulting to 'handle' method if not specified.

methods.name: resolveMiddleware
methods.description: Resolves middleware, defaulting to 'process' method if not specified.

methods.name: resolveByPredicate
methods.description: Helper to resolve callables based on a predicate, used for routes and middleware.

methods.name: isRoute
methods.description: Checks if a value is a RequestHandlerInterface.

methods.name: isMiddleware
methods.description: Checks if a value is a MiddlewareInterface.

methods.name: resolveSlimNotation
methods.description: Parses notation like 'ClassName:method' and resolves to an instance and method, using container if available.

methods.name: assertCallable
methods.description: Ensures a resolved value is callable, throws exception if not.

methods.name: bindToContainer
methods.description: Binds a Closure to the container if applicable.

methods.name: prepareToResolve
methods.description: Prepares various input formats into a standard callable or notation string.
